title: John Ford's prosecution

tellings.quote: governing body by poisoning his toothpaste with radioactive material.

plain: In the 1990s on Long Island, a man named John Ford was prosecuted, accused of a plot against members of a local governing body that involved poisoning one man's toothpaste with radioactive material. The researcher Richard Dolan tells Michels this without naming a source, and he also mentions a person named Elaine Douglas. Dolan tells it as part of a wider talk about the price some people paid for pursuing UFOs, though he does not spell out the link.
